findings.details: Candidates encode only selected liquidity or staffing controls and do not represent the broader business-impact assessment, operational or technology enhancements, client communications, or optional staffing permission in the paired claims.
The Canada-inclusive liquidity candidate does not state the foreign-exchange T+2 premise or condition its result on cross-currency transactions.
The staffing candidate does not encode the optional permission to consider shift changes, extended hours, evening or morning duties, or automation.

deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 extend the expressly US-specific settlement-funding requirement to Canada; the definition of Transition does not expressly authorize that substitution.

deferred.de17849c793b3b50e64af178 and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 assess one selected transaction without establishing coverage of all relevant transactions or expressly considering settlement-failure risk.
claim.e54bdacf136416fee195e709 incorrectly makes potentially considerable US exposure an applicability condition; the source uses 'particularly' to emphasize a subset of fund management companies.
None of the candidates encodes Canada's 27 May 2024 effective date; the candidates mentioning Canadian settlements therefore retain only part of the selected definition.
The candidates assess particular readiness measures; their TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT results cannot establish compliance with the circular's other obligations.

deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 extend the specific US-securities funding requirement to Canadian securities; the definition of Transition does not establish that extension of the expressly US-specific language in d2ccfaeb3eb4b.u3.996.

deferred.de17849c793b3b50e64af178 and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 assess one selected transaction without implementing an aggregation over the LC's relevant transactions, so their results do not establish firm-wide compliance.
The transaction-level candidates mention cross-currency timing in funding availability but do not separately establish consideration of potential settlement failures required by d2ccfaeb3eb4b.u3.996.
All candidates implement selected controls only; TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT must not be interpreted as compliance with the entire circular, whose readiness measures are non-exhaustive.

deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 extend the express US-securities funding requirement to Canadian transactions; the definition of Transition does not expressly broaden provisions specifically referring to US securities.
deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d also extends the express US/foreign-exchange mismatch and settlement-failure consideration to Canadian business without explicit source support.
The transaction-level candidates do not aggregate results across an LC's transactions; a successful selected-transaction check cannot establish corporation-wide compliance.
All candidates implement only selected controls, so TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT must be confined to those controls rather than treated as compliance with the circular's overall readiness requirements.

The extracted appropriateness claim is supported by the surrounding requirement for appropriate measures, but the grammatical reach of 'where appropriate' across the entire enhancement list remains ambiguous.
The candidates do not explicitly encode SHOULD modality; their Boolean results should be understood as checking satisfaction of recommendations, not establishing a stronger mandatory legal duty.

deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 extend the specifically US funding requirement to Canadian securities without express support; the definition of Transition does not replace explicit references to US securities.
deferred.a77999236b850ca0d170d02d also extends the specifically US-securities/foreign-exchange mismatch requirement to Canadian business without express support.

deferred.de17849c793b3b50e64af178 and deferred.87d5acf69c04ac010d0cc805 assess a selected transaction without implementing aggregation across the LC's relevant transactions, so transaction-level success cannot establish LC-wide compliance.
The candidates' TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT outputs can establish only compliance with represented requirements, not overall circular compliance; none implements client engagement.
The source uses SHOULD for the assessed duties; Boolean compliance tests must not be interpreted as establishing a stronger statutory MUST.
deferred.161f6067107f34efecf1b3ed does not explicitly resolve post-trade settlement processes to include trade allocation, confirmation and affirmation, as specified in d2ccfaeb3eb4b.u16.3567.
